features.name: oc_mean_words_per_sentence
features.definition: Across all counter-argument comments, what is the average number of words per sentence?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of strings; if missing/malformed return null; if empty list return null. Concatenate all comments' text. Split into sentences with a regex on terminal punctuation (re.split(r'(?<=[.!?])\s+|\n+', text)), dropping empty segments. Words = regex tokens re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9']+", text). Return total words / total sentences across all comments (pooled); null if zero sentences.

h0: oc_mean_words_per_sentence has no association with delta.
h1: Lower oc_mean_words_per_sentence is associated with higher probability of delta (negative coefficient).
note: Persuasiveness operationalised as OP view change (delta). Sentence splitting is a regex heuristic; pooled across all comments (words/sentences), not per-comment mean. Raw text may include quotations, markdown, URLs, and outcome announcements; not filtered. Association only.
